1323-2092-4687--205.manaNeeded: {0} plus enough to animate the land
1323-2092-4687--205.easyPrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Gilder Bairn has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a land that can add {G} or {U}.
1323-2092-4687--205.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 2 power.
1323-2092-4687--205.description:
Use any of the listed land animators to turn a land that can produce {G} or {U} into a land creature and put at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using that land's ability by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat from step 2.

719-728-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-728-4302.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

454-1978-7935.description:
Cause Gumato to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Gumato by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gumato.
Repeat from step 2.

4017-5870-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-5870-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-2866-4659-7646.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Krallenhorde Howler.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Krallenhorde Howler.
Repeat.

2034-6461--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-5086-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Triskelavus.
When Triskelavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
2034-5086-6972.notes:
You can sacrifice the Triskelavite tokens to their own abilities to deal infinite damage.
Each loop, you can use mana from the previous loop and remove a +1/+1 counter from Triskelavus to make creature tokens.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

573-3177-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
573-3177-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1283-1765-2440-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {5}, creating a token copy of it.
Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
Repeat.
1283-1765-2440-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

252-1575-5776-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1061-1115-4603.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-1115-4603.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-1115-4603.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

997-2730-3175.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

465-2921-4681.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2781-6767.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Rescue Skiff
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

6761-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Scouring Swarm trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
6761-6797-7084.notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wylie Duke with "Kraken" chosen

1238-2351-5467-6797-7040.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1563-2457-6968.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3532-3581-5078-6607.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

141-313-2921.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-313-2921.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2639-3254-4050-4415.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-4050-4415.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Stonecloaker and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Stonecloaker and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-4050-4415.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

4375-5231-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

1274-2541-4869.notablePrerequisites:
Glint-Horn Buccaneer has lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
1274-2541-4869.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1238-2351-4452-5467-6798.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

1021-4050-5413-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-4050-5413-6761.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {1}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-4050-5413-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

997-2060-3054-6701.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
997-2060-3054-6701.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
997-2060-3054-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

673-813-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Planar Incision.
673-813-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

800-1902-4116.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
800-1902-4116.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Wirewood Channeler.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

1819-4211-5510-5512.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of copies of Relentless Rats in your library greater than your maximum hand size minus the number of cards in your hand.
1819-4211-5510-5512.description:
Cast Secret Salvage by paying {3}{B}{B}, exiling Relentless Rats from your graveyard and causing you to search your library for all copies of Relentless Rats in your library and put them into your hand.
Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard as many copies of Relentless Rats as possible.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card discarded this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card exiled this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

914-1075-2068-4050.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1075-2068-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {B}.
Activate Bonecaller Cleric by paying {3}{B} and sacrificing it, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Bonecaller Cleric's ability, with the copy targeting Bonecaller Cleric.
Resolve both Bonecaller Cleric abilities, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

215-3172-3499.notablePrerequisites: Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {7}{G}{G}{G}.
215-3172-3499.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {7}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Patron of the Orochi by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Patron of the Orochi to your hand.
Cast Patron of the Orochi by paying {6}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {8}{G}{G}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana.

886-1371-1396-2836.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You have at least eight cards in hand, or an opponent except the opponent directly to your right has at least six cards in hand.
Your deck size is less than 90, or each opponent has a deck size of 91 or less.
886-1371-1396-2836.description:
Cast Pure Intentions by paying {W}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Pure Intentions.
Resolve all Pure Intentions.
Cast Whispering Madness by paying {2}{U}{B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Whispering Madness.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Whispering Madness, causing each player to discard their hand and draw cards equal to the greatest number of cards discarded this way.
Each player who did not control Whispering Madness's Pure Intentions triggers.
Resolve all Pure Intentions, causing you and the opponents to return to their hand all cards discarded by Whispering Madness.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining Whispering Madness until you either draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game due to Laboratory Maniac, or until your opponents lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

3976-4872.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3976-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Time Warp and putting it face down as a 3/3 creature.
Move to your next turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the face down creature.
The face down creature triggers, causing you to cast a copy of Time Warp without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

643-659-2534.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating X 1/1 Goblin creature tokens, where X is the number of creatures you control.
When each creature token enters the battlefield, it triggers Coercive Recruiter.
Resolve one Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Krenko.
Repeat any number of times.
Resolve all remaining Coercive Recruiter triggers, targeting any creatures on the battlefield.

3350-3859-4695.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortality triggers.
Activate Cavern Harpy by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 2 until you have zero life.
Resolve the last Cavern Harpy trigger, returning it to your hand.
The remaining Cavern Harpy triggers fizzle.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.

3554-4872-5273.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Diabolic Tutor by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Diabolic Tutor and Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

413-1020-2478-4986.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at the top card of a player's library and drawing a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Retriever.
Myr Retriever triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
